details.name: DivX Web Player 1.4 (DivX 7) and below
details.who: All Firefox users who have versions of the DivX Web Player plugin lower than 1.4.
details.why: Old versions of the DivX Web Player plugin are causing significant stability problems on Firefox 18 and above, on Mac OS X. All users should update their DivX software to the latest available version, available at divx.com.
